thesis: Triskelion packages a creature, removal spell, and combo piece into one artifact by converting +1/+1 counters directly into damage.

canonicalIdentity.originalPrintedText: This creature enters with three +1/+1 counters on it. Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: It deals 1 damage to any target.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Triskelion moved from early artifact control to Tinker, Reanimator, and infinite-combo shells, becoming one of Magic’s longest-lived modular finishers.
